title: Pullman's Prairie front steps back in three, as the photographs show
items: The Pullman house's Prairie Avenue front now steps back three times from its north end: the portico block, then a narrow banded step under its own slate roof, then the wall running to the 18th Street corner.
The middle step stands where the 1911 fire-insurance map draws it and where the Detroit and 1890 pictures show a narrow banded face between the portico and the big dormer.
